title: Shared Services Schema Definitions
description: Reusable $defs for services schemas across all NVD designs. Only resources whose shape is identical across every design live here; design-specific resources (bridgeDomain, irbInterface, routedInterface, staticRoute, routingPolicy) stay local to each design schema.

node_selector.description: Label selectors to match nodes for this router (e.g. 'eda.nokia.com/role=leaf').

export_target.description: Optional BGP-EVPN export route target (e.g. 'target:1:777'). Overrides the default 'target:1:<evi>'.

import_target.description: Optional BGP-EVPN import route target (e.g. 'target:1:777'). Overrides the default 'target:1:<evi>'.

bridge_domain.description: Bridge domain this VLAN belongs to (must exist in bridge_domains).

vlan_id.description: VLAN ID ('untagged' or numeric string like '10').

interface_selector.description: Label selectors to match interfaces for this VLAN.
